positive: Scene: Low view along a gutter littered with small crumpled balls of foil glinting in the light. Behind, out of focus, people linger on the sidewalk among carts, crates and a broken bicycle; a figure sits bent forward, gently swaying. Low wide shot from curb height, 28mm. Camera at gutter level, very slow push forward along the curb. Placement: Foreground foil at (0.30, 0.15); background figures soft along y=0.40–0.60. L1 Blue hour; foil picks up the amber of the streetlamps.
